title: Setting Key Performance Indicators (KPIs)
overview: This course delves into the essential world of Key Performance Indicators (KPIs), exploring their various types, applications, and significance in different areas of business. Participants will learn a step-by-step approach to developing effective KPIs and creating the appropriate dashboards or scorecards for monitoring and reporting these metrics to their line managers.
audience: This course is ideal for managers and senior professionals who play a role in influencing, formulating, or supporting the long-term planning and strategy of their department or organization.
methodology: The course emphasizes hands-on learning through a series of workshops where participants will practice the analysis and development of various types of KPIs. These team-based workshops utilize customized case studies designed to stimulate critical thinking around KPI development.
objectivesIntro: By the end of the course, participants will be able to:
objectives: Design a performance measurement system using their understanding of KPIs, including their roles, types, and applications
Identify and develop the most relevant KPIs for stakeholders and customers
Create KPIs that drive internal quality and productivity improvements
Manage the KPI measurement process effectively through all stages
Utilize tools to ensure the successful implementation of a KPI project
